limitations: Single-source discovery; not independently corroborated or complete coverage.
No model probabilities or verified Sky Bet odds. Price movements are research inputs only.
Race times interpreted in Europe/London. Completed races are retained as source observations, never new forecasts.
Runner status and form are single-source observations, not independent verification.
Doubtful runners remain visible but block full-field forecasts and quoted favourites.
Separately displayed market observations are third-party quotes, not verified executable bookmaker prices.
Historical rows are date-filtered before race/capture day; their historical availability is not attested.
Tips, commentary, current-race finishing positions and bookmaker prices are excluded from runner features.

market_history_status.limitation: Source capture changes do not establish value or win probability. Changed fields/markets are not directly compared.
